Cobweb diagram

80
Dark curve: f(x) · dashed line: y = x

The cobweb starts on y = x. Each vertical segment applies f; each horizontal segment returns to the diagonal. Discard shifts the displayed starting iterate, while the orbit is still seeded at its critical point.

The background and contour geometry are fixed from the saved GPU sweep. Orbit values are calculated locally at your exact selected (u, v), rather than at the nearest grid sample. Chaotic trajectories may differ from the GPU trajectories through rounding. Escape is reported only after crossing a parameter-dependent bound that guarantees continued growth.
